normalization_plan.reason: The parameter has no independent state; it is immediately assigned to _tBotAddress inside setBlackListBot.
The parameter is only consumed by the _tBlackAddress write in setBlackAddress.
The parameter exists solely to compute _maxBlack inside setMaxTxBlack.
The sender parameter is a transient argument of the internal _transfer balance debit.
The recipient parameter is a transient argument of the internal _transfer balance credit.
The amount parameter is only meaningful within the _transfer cap check and balance updates.
The parameter only exists to be written into the privileged _owner state variable during transferOwnership.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key inside _approve.
The owner parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key inside _approve.
The local c is a temporary checked result inside SafeMath.add and carries no separate meaning.
The local codehash is a temporary extcodehash result evaluated only inside isContract.
